record.original_question: Can the relation between supergravity holographic renormalization and the string-theory computation of AdS3/CFT2 correlators be made systematic, so that the volume renormalization that renders string correlators finite and the map between worldsheet vertex operators and CFT operators are understood as precisely as the corresponding bulk-field boundary-condition dictionary in supergravity?

evidence.quote: renormalization has not been systematically developed and applied in this context.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider type IIB string theory on AdS_3 × S^3 × M (with M either T^4 or K3) with NS-NS flux, dual via the AdS_3/CFT_2 correspondence to a two-dimensional superconformal field theory on the boundary. On the bulk side, two complementary frameworks compute boundary correlation functions:

(a) Supergravity holographic renormalization. One regularizes the on-shell supergravity action by cutting off the asymptotically AdS region at a finite radial coordinate, adds covariant boundary counterterms determined by the asymptotic expansion of the bulk fields, and extracts CFT correlators by functional differentiation with respect to prescribed boundary data. This produces a precise dictionary in which each bulk supergravity field is identified, via its leading and subleading falloffs, with a specific source and a specific operator of definite conformal weight in the dual CFT.

(b) Worldsheet string theory on AdS_3 (described by an SL(2,R) WZW model times an internal CFT). Boundary correlators are computed as integrated worldsheet correlation functions of physical vertex operators, and require a renormalization of the divergent volume of the target AdS_3 (equivalently, a regularization of certain divergences in the moduli/spectral-flow integrals) to yield finite answers.

Formulate and prove a systematic prescription that (i) defines the volume renormalization rendering all string-theory boundary correlators finite, in a scheme-independent way comparable to holographic renormalization in supergravity, and (ii) provides an explicit, systematic map between worldsheet vertex operators (including their spectral-flow sectors and internal-CFT factors) and local operators in the dual two-dimensional CFT, such that the resulting prescription reduces, in the supergravity limit, to the standard bulk-field/boundary-operator dictionary of holographic renormalization, and agrees with it on the level of two- and three-point correlation functions.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is a research-program proposal asking for a systematic worldsheet analogue of holographic renormalization for AdS_3/CFT_2. There is substantial subsequent work on AdS_3 string correlators (e.g., Eberhardt, Dei–Eberhardt and others on the symmetric-orbifold/tensionless point), but a complete, systematic worldsheet renormalization framework matching supergravity holographic renormalization in full generality does not appear to have been definitively established. Status is best classified as unknown/open.
